name: tools_nextflow_annotate
description: Annotate a COPY of a Nextflow (nf-core) pipeline such as taxteller so every process task reports its activity and entities to moirai: a bash EXIT trap at the top of each process script block calls a generated helper, idempotent marked blocks, Groovy escaping of $ and backslash, entity plan per process (reads, results, databases by path size mtime, seqscreen run directory, recentrifuge reports), entity relations and a diagram, a moirai_overlay.config (env, podman bind mounts of the helper, moirai python and /dev/shm) and the job-script lines (dftracer with moirai, one moirai-service per node). Load for the annotate stage of a Nextflow pipeline, when a process script needs provenance, when nextflow -preview or a parse fails after annotation, when a process exit status or caching changed, or when the annotated task records nothing.

history.why: Taxteller (pipeline tax-teller-20261112-142121) is a Nextflow pipeline; prov_annotate supports Python, C/C++ and Maestro yaml_step only (lesson L-7bfd89de planned a separate step capability). User approved the process/entity diagram and said "ok continue the pipeline". Stage 1 of the staging order (L-3c35680e, L-cc2ec2c8): skill plus a stub tool; the whole tool_code follows by capability_refine.

Fix 1: _check_tree anchor compared an index of the STRIPPED text with the ANNOTATED lines, so every process after the first annotated one in a file failed (taxteller custom_kaiju/main.nf holds six). The opener is now mapped to the annotated text (_anchored). Fix 2: nextflow -preview ran inside the annotated copy and left .nextflow.log and .nextflow there, so stray_files failed on the next validate; _nf_parse now sends the log to a temp dir and removes the byproducts it created. Two new selftest checks (21 and 22 of 22).

Bug: the hook block passed --container "${task.container}" raw but the helper base64-decodes it (_b64(a.container)), so the container input and the software container@... entity were garbage on every process (e.g. container@<binary> for null). Encode it like key/ext with (task.container ?: ''), have the helper skip an empty or 'null' container, teach the preview renderer the Elvis form, and add selftest checks (container recorded verbatim; empty/null records none).
